correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all 24 lexicographically ordered permutations, six transposition generators and graph shortest distances; the cycle formula d(p,q)=4-c(p^{-1}q) agrees with the generator metric. Scale 1 is connected, bipartite and triangle-free with 24 vertices/72 edges, giving 49 circles. Diameter 3 makes scale >=3 a simplex. Independently reimplemented scale-2 clique enumeration from permutation distances and obtained f=(24,204,800,1632,2040,2008,1608,990,440,132,24,2), total 9,904 nonempty simplices. Reconstructed the staged all-vertex matching: 4,935 disjoint codimension-one pairs, 34 critical faces (one 0-simplex and 33 3-simplices). Built the entire oriented face Hasse diagram with 56,328 incidences and exhaustively topologically sorted all 9,904 face-nodes; no directed cycles. Finite acyclic discrete Morse theory gives a CW complex with one 0-cell and 33 3-cells attached to a point, therefore exactly a wedge of 33 S^3 integrally. Filtration jumps at 0/1/2/3 only; the positive-dimensional persistence degrees cannot persist across distinct nonzero-degree adjacent stages, so the stated barcodes follow. This exhaustive finite certificate tests precisely S4 and no n>4 generalization.
